name: Technical Report
description: A long-form technical report, assessment, or research document
audience: technical stakeholders or client technical team
layout_notes: Include a table of contents. Use numbered headings. For very long reports (>20 pages), consider LaTeX format — ask the user if they want DOCX or LaTeX.

required_sections.title: Cover Page
required_sections.description: Report title, prepared by, prepared for, date, version, classification

required_sections.title: Executive Summary
required_sections.description: 1-page summary of purpose, approach, key findings, and recommendations

required_sections.title: Methodology
required_sections.description: How the work was conducted — tools, frameworks, data sources

required_sections.title: Findings
required_sections.description: The main body — detailed results, analysis, evidence

optional_sections.title: Appendices
optional_sections.description: Supporting data, raw results, or additional detail
